manifest.citation: Kanamitsu, M., et al. (2002). NCEP-DOE AMIP-II Reanalysis (R-2). Bull. Amer. Meteor. Soc., 83, 1631-1643. Data provided by the NOAA PSL, Boulder, Colorado, USA, from their website at https://psl.noaa.gov. 10 m wind subset 2015-01-05T00:00:00Z to 2015-01-08T18:00:00Z.
manifest.gridMeaning: T62 Gaussian latitudes retained as stored (spacing ≈1.9047° but not exactly uniform); regular 1.875° longitudes
manifest.license: No restrictions stated by provider; acknowledgment of NOAA PSL requested.

processingHistory.fillPolicy: missing values become null; never zero
processingHistory.operation: netCDF4 mask-and-scale decode; drop singleton level axis
reverse latitude axis to ascending together with data planes (no resampling)

manifest.sourceSha256Scope: SHA-256 of canonical JSON ordered original-subset metadata list (acquisition sources)
manifest.timeMeaning: file time coordinate taken as the valid time of the 6-hourly forecast (provider long_name '6-Hourly Forecast of U-wind at 10 m')
